other_names: Sinixt Confederacy; Arrow Lakes Band (Indian Act name); Lakes Tribe (Colville Confederated Tribes)
notes_factual_only: SCC case summary: reserve set aside for the Arrow Lakes in 1902; in 1956 the federal government declared the Arrow Lakes Band extinct for the purposes of the Indian Act. Own site describes the nation as a transboundary tribe and an Aboriginal people of Canada. No Arrow Lakes band appears in the ISC First Nation list.
